best_idea: Write each fight event once with a private version for one seat and a shared version for everyone else, then let the server set each viewer's channel, so spectators, a coach and the owner all read one record and no client chooses what it sees.
decision_why: Frankendom has one ledger and server-verified kills, and the donor's viewer channel is set by the server (room-battle.ts:143), which fits; drop the text protocol and key channels by role (spectator, coach, combatant), not by seat number, because MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 makes four combatants and a spectator and a coach are roles.
acceptance: A Pit bout test with a coach seat asserts that the spectator view contains no coach-only line, the coach view contains it, and the owner/debug view contains both.
